name: Ezekiel Marchetti-Owusu
title: Principal Engineer
summary: Principal engineer with sixteen years across payments, logistics and healthcare data. Leads architecture for systems that move money and medicine, writes the code that matters most, and builds the teams that keep it running. Known for turning incident reviews into roadmaps and for leaving every codebase easier to change than it was found.
